column1: content
Captain Reyes commands the Royal Guard at Northgate and inspects the gate every morning.
Mira the healer tends to wounded travelers at the village clinic beside the Market Square.
Aldric leads the Merchants Guild and keeps his stall open from dawn until dusk.
Finn the scout found large tracks near the forest edge and warned the village.
Bran runs the Silver Inn and charges extra for quiet rooms.
The kingdom of Ashvale lies north of the Greywood Forest.
King Aldric II rules from the capital, but Captain Reyes holds Northgate in his absence.
The Merchants Guild meets weekly in the Market Square to settle disputes.
A forest wyrm was spotted near the eastern trail last winter.
The Royal Guard patrols the northern road between Northgate and the Silver Inn.
Mira learned herb-craft from the monks of the eastern hills.
Finn grew up in Ashvale and knows every path through the Greywood.
Aldric once loaned the guild treasury to rebuild the Northgate barracks.
Bran inherited the Silver Inn from his uncle and has run it for twelve years.
Travelers say the wyrm leaves tracks the size of wagon wheels.
Captain Reyes served under the previous king before Aldric II took the throne.
The Market Square fills with merchants every market day.
Mira's clinic treats farmers from the eastern fields when fever spreads.
Finn refuses to enter the deep forest alone after dark.
The Silver Inn sits on the road between Northgate and the capital.
